test_item:
The system shall guarantee that all imported client keys are encrypted using the KeyMint AIDL HAL and stored in a location immune to user-initiated erasures (e.g., Factory Reset).
(key blob remains accessible after a factory reset)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. A key blob is installed on the DUT
3. A factory reset has been performed
4. The DUT has been power cycled
proc:
1. Confirm the content of /mnt/vendor/oemkeys on the DUT
$ adb shell ls -l /mnt/vendor/oemkeys
er: 1. The adb shell ls -l /mnt/vendor/oemkeys output lists the stored key blob
design: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
